source_policy.allowed_sources: Current official college catalogs, official college program pages, and official college policy pages only. A third-party-hosted file is accepted only when the current official college catalog page links to that exact file.
source_policy.transfer_virginia_role: Transfer Virginia may be named by an official catalog as an option-set or advising source, but it was not used by itself to establish that a program exists, its award, or its graduation rules.
source_policy.schedule_exclusion: Prospective schedules and term class listings are not evidence that an award exists.
source_policy.unknown_rule: A null value means the reviewed current official sources did not state the value; it must not be interpreted as zero or as not applicable.

findings: Reynolds, Camp, and Tidewater each publish a current Computer Science Associate of Science transfer degree.
Richard Bland does not publish a standalone Computer Science A.S.; it publishes a current combined Math/Computer Science, A.S. with a Computer Science branch inside the quantitative requirement.
The three missing structural records are capture/discovery failures, not defensible no-program findings.

institutions.name: Reynolds Community College

catalog.evidence: The current catalog selector and page heading identify catoid 13 as the Reynolds College 2026-2027 Catalog.

published_total_credits.interpretation: The base award is variable by transfer destination. The catalog publishes separate BA-oriented and BS-oriented maps rather than one universal course table.

degree.purpose: Transfer preparation for a bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.

program_maps.total_credits: same award; sequence is spread across additional terms
same award; sequence is spread across additional terms

common_general_education_slots.rule: choose one UCGS Social/Behavioral Science elective
choose one UCGS Humanities/Fine Arts elective
choose one UCGS Humanities/Fine Arts/Literature elective from a different discipline area than humanities_1

ba_destination_map.note: MTH 245 is the printed BA-map course; transfer-destination substitutions require advisor review.

ba_destination_map.credits: 4 or higher based on university needs

bs_destination_map.rule: choose with an advisor for the intended four-year institution; one of the three is specifically labeled UCGS Approved Elective

requirement_logic.sequence_note: The catalog says courses should be taken in the listed order. MTH 167 may be used as preparatory elective credit when additional preparation is needed.

general_education_and_electives.authority: Reynolds Approved Transfer Electives, including Passport and UCGS markings
general_education_and_electives.evidence: The current official page enumerates the Arts/Humanities/Literature, Natural Sciences, Mathematics, Social and Behavioral Sciences/History, World Languages, and additional UCGS Block VII choices used by the maps.

Submit the graduation application by the published deadline.

capture_and_parser_blockers: The base Computer Science AS page contains no course list. The actual requirements are four linked BA/BS, full-time/part-time program-map records, so a one-page program extractor will always return an empty tree.
Direct HTTP clients currently receive an AWS WAF 202 challenge with an empty body. A real-browser session completed the challenge and exposed the current catoid 13 pages.
The repository's earlier catoid 10 map identifiers are stale; the current catalog uses catoid 13 and different poids.
The degree is destination-sensitive. Collapsing the BA and BS maps into one flat AND list would overstate requirements.

sources.evidence: Current Computer Science AS transfer award and links to all four program maps.
Current official UCGS, Passport, and broader transfer-elective course lists.
Current 2.0 curriculum GPA and 25-percent Reynolds-credit rules.

institutions.name: Camp Community College

catalog.platform: official college landing page linking a Google Drive PDF
catalog.evidence: The current official catalog landing page labels the linked cover as 2026-27; the linked PDF contains the 2026-2027 academic calendar and current programs.

degree.purpose: A university-parallel transfer degree aligned to the VCCS common curriculum for Computer Science.

choice_slots.rule: choose any UCGS-approved Humanities, Art, or Literature course
choose an Arts/Literature elective from a different humanities subgroup than the first choice; some universities require literature
choose any UCGS-approved Social Science course
choose any UCGS-approved Natural Science course
choose a TransferVA-approved Science course as required by the official catalog
choice_slots.note: The program footnote says PHY 202 should be considered only for B.A. Computer Science transfer paths.

choice_slots.known_course_credit_issue: MTH 245 is ordinarily a three-credit VCCS course, while the table prints four credits for the combined slot.

requirement_logic.programming_language_note: The catalog says Camp currently uses C++ for CSC 221 and CSC 222 and Java for CSC 223; destination-language needs require advance advising.

legacy_teachout.catalog_program_title: General Studies - Specialization in Computer Science
legacy_teachout.interpretation: This remains in the current catalog only for already-enrolled teachout students. New students from Fall 2024 forward enter the Computer Science A.S., plan 246.

general_education_and_electives.evidence: The official PDF publishes the college-wide elective rules, General Education Passport, and the courses applicable to General Education and UCGS. The program table narrows those option sets for this award.

residency.unit: percent of degree credits acquired at Camp

graduation_constraints.catalog_of_record: Use the catalog in effect at entry or a later selected catalog; after an interruption of four or more consecutive non-summer semesters, use the catalog in effect at re-entry.
other_rules: Complete all course and credit-hour requirements.
File the graduation application and resolve college obligations.

data_quality_flags: The current program's first-term rows total 16 credits, but the table prints 17. The four printed term totals therefore sum to 62 while the program total is 61.
The MTH 264/MTH 245 row prints four credits although MTH 245 is normally three credits; selecting Statistics can change the arithmetic unless another credit is supplied.

The official marketing page still labels plan 246 as General Studies-Computer Science and calls the award Associate of Arts and Sciences, while the current catalog unambiguously identifies plan 246 as the new Computer Science Associate of Science. The catalog controls.
The PDF metadata title says 2024-2025 even though the file was created in July 2026 and its actual contents are the 2026-2027 catalog. Content and official landing-page label control.
capture_and_parser_blockers: There is no catalog application or per-program HTML. The scraper must discover the first current Google Drive file linked from the official landing page, download it, verify PDF magic, and retain the PDF hash.
The 341-page PDF contains both a discontinued teachout specialization and the replacement A.S. A heading-only search for Computer Science can select the wrong award.
The generic PDF parser needs page-window citations and must preserve the cross-category humanities rule, the dynamic UCGS/TransferVA science option sets, and the MTH 264-or-MTH 245 alternative.
The source itself has credit arithmetic conflicts, so successful extraction must remain review-required rather than silently forcing the stated 61-credit total.

sources.evidence: Official Camp page linking the current 2026-27 catalog and subsequent archived catalogs.
Officially linked 2026-2027 catalog PDF; program pages 265-267 and graduation page 64.
Official page confirms plan 246 is intended for Computer Science transfer, but its displayed title and award lag the current catalog.

institutions.name: Tidewater Community College

catalog.evidence: The current catalog selector, program page, and policy pages identify catoid 23 as the 2026-2027 Catalog.

published_total_credits.interpretation: The catalog range controls because alternative math and elective choices carry different credit values.

degree.purpose: Transfer preparation for a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science.

options.replacement: use Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, or Foreign Language electives for the displaced preparation credits

choice_slots.rule: choose one General Education Social Science elective other than History

choice_slots.minimum_total_rule: The completed program must contain at least 60 credits; a second lab science is recommended and some transfer institutions require a science sequence.

requirement_logic.distinct_slot_warning: The two semester-4 technical slots have overlapping options. They must remain separate requirement nodes, and one course must not be used to satisfy both slots.

general_education_core.evidence: Current official option lists for Communication, Mathematics, Natural Science with Lab, Humanities, and Social Science. It also states that one course cannot satisfy more than one curriculum requirement.

approved_transfer_electives.evidence: Current official transfer-elective dictionary for destination-sensitive elective slots.

residency.unit: percent of degree credit hours earned in coursework at TCC

graduation_constraints.catalog_of_record: Use the catalog in effect at admission to the curriculum or a later catalog chosen by the student, provided it is not more than six years old including the graduation year.
other_rules: Complete all curriculum course and credit-hour requirements.
Apply for graduation by the published deadline.
Resolve college obligations and receive official certification.

data_quality_flags: The official marketing page publishes 61 credits while the current catalog publishes 60-63; the catalog range reflects variable-credit alternatives.

Footnote 8 is grammatically malformed and does not cleanly delimit whether 'additional science plus PHY 201' is one sequence or multiple menu items. This slot requires a human read before verification.
Footnotes 7 and 8 create overlapping CSC 205/CSC 215 choices in two separate semester-4 slots. A flat set loses the two-slot requirement.

The catoid 23 catalog home page is headed 2026-2027 but still contains a sentence telling users that the toolbar accesses 2024-2025 information. The heading, current selector, and individual program/policy pages consistently identify 2026-2027.
capture_and_parser_blockers: Cloudflare returns a 403 challenge to curl and generic HTTP fetches. A real Chrome browser session with challenge wait reaches the page.

The current TCC marketing page's View Curriculum link still targets catoid 21/poid 4756. That archived URL redirects to the current catoid 23 catalog home page instead of the program, so discovery must search the current catalog navigation or use catoid 23/poid 5235.
The Acalog parser must retain numbered footnotes, nested all-of versus one-of math preparation, category-distinct humanities choices, and two separate technical slots.
A warm browser profile or challenge-aware browser capture is required; retrying the same raw request will not produce catalog content.

sources.evidence: Current Computer Science A.S., program code 246, requirements, footnotes, and 60-63-credit total.
Current category lists and two-of-three humanities-category rule.
Current 2.0 applicable-study GPA and 25-percent TCC-credit rules.
Official TCC page confirms a four-semester, 61-credit Computer Science A.S. and online/campus availability.

institutions.name: Richard Bland College

catalog.platform: Modern Campus Catalog (Acalog) on an HTTP-only catalog host
catalog.evidence: The current catalog selector and page heading identify catoid 10 as the 2026-2027 College Catalog.

degree.official_site_title: Associate of Science Degree - Math/Computer Science (A.S.-Math/Computer Science)
degree.program_scope: combined mathematics and computer science transfer award
degree.purpose: Transfer preparation for applied quantitative fields. The official program index identifies Math/Computer Science as one combined A.S., not a standalone Computer Science award.

general_education_slots.rule: choose one three-credit course from the program page's enumerated communication, literature, philosophy, and religion list
choose one three-credit course from the program page's enumerated art, music, and theatre list
choose one three-credit course from the program page's enumerated anthropology, philosophy, psychology, religion, and sociology list
choose one three-credit course from the program page's enumerated economics, geography, government, history, philosophy, and religion list

additional_rule.mathematics_branch: Take MATH 261 and at least one of MATH 254 or MATH 271.

electives.hard_rule: Complete enough electives to reach the degree total.
recommendations_not_requirements: 3-6 credits in Mathematics, with MATH 261 and MATH 271 named as recommendations
4-12 credits in Natural Sciences based on the intended transfer institution
no more than two additional Physical Education credits may count as electives

requirement_logic.foreign_language: Not required for this degree. The catalog recommends checking the intended transfer institution's foreign-language requirements.
requirement_logic.computer_proficiency: Satisfied through the Quantitative and Symbolic Reasoning component; no additional course is required.

general_education_and_electives.evidence: The program page enumerates every broad General Education menu and states the quantitative branch, natural-science pair, elective range, and 60-credit total.

residency.unit: credits completed at Richard Bland College
residency.evidence: The current official advising FAQ requires at least 30 of the minimum 60 degree credits at RBC.

last_hours_residency.evidence: Older RBC catalogs imposed a nine-of-the-last-fifteen rule, but the current catalog page and current official advising FAQ reviewed for this batch do not state it; do not carry the historical rule forward without registrar confirmation.

other_rules: Complete all course requirements for the selected degree.
Meet with the learner mentor and submit the graduation application.

capture_and_parser_blockers: Richard Bland is not a VCCS college and uses institution-local codes such as CSCI 221/222 and MATH 251/252. These must not be joined to the VCCS course dictionary solely by normalized code.
The catalog host is HTTP-only and currently applies an AWS WAF 202 challenge to raw requests; a real browser reaches the page.

The award combines Mathematics and Computer Science. A parser that keeps only 'choose at least seven credits' loses the branch condition that Computer Science students must take CSCI 222 and one Mathematics option.
The 15-16 elective block mixes hard credit totals with nonbinding recommendations. Recommended Mathematics and Natural Science courses must not be converted into additional AND requirements.
The current official residency rule is published in an advising PDF rather than the program catalog page, so policy-layer composition is required.

sources.evidence: Current combined Math/Computer Science A.S., program logic, and 60-credit total.
Current official site identifies the combined A.S.-Math/Computer Science award and CIP 30.0801; it lists no standalone Computer Science A.S.
Current catalog states the 2.0 GPA expected for graduation.
Current official FAQ states 60 total credits, 30 completed at RBC, and a 2.0 cumulative GPA.
